name: Ed Gallrein
desc: American retired Navy SEAL officer and farmer (born 1958)
summary:
Edward Gibson Gallrein III (born April 20, 1958) is an American farmer and former Navy SEAL officer. A member of the Republican Party, Gallrein is the incoming United States Representative for Kentucky's 4th congressional district, elected in 2026 and due to take office in 2027.
Gallrein defeated Republican seven-term incumbent Thomas Massie in the most expensive primary election in U.S. congressional history, and then defeated Democratic nominee Melissa Strange and Libertarian candidate Jeremy Todd in the general election.
